notes: CBSA's account-control service (ACCTCTRL) on GENERATED Db2 rows (#4507): 30 IBMUSER.ACCOUNT rows built from CRETB01's CREATE TABLE and CREI101's unique index (every column at its boundaries, a NULL in every nullable column; a quarter under another sort code), so SELECT COUNT(*) over the program's own sort code (987654) counts a table nobody wrote by hand; the count is whatever the generator drew, compared on both sides with what Db2 answered (compare_sql), and the table after every task. The caller-data and -913 hand scenarios of cbsa-acctctrl stay. Burned estate (CBSA).
